name: audit-documentation
title: Documentation template conformance audit
outcome: A read-only, revision-bound per-page template conformance report with host-counted coverage and no model calls.

steps.title: Audit pages against their templates
steps.prompt: Enumerate every documentation page in the declared scope, map each page to a governed template from its frontmatter or path conventions, and run the structural template checks on every mapped page. Report each unmapped or refused page with its reason. Never guess a template, call a model, or modify files.
